info.name: Student App (Flutter) — localhost
info.description:
Student APK API. Full localhost URLs (API gateway :5000), no baseUrl variable.
Run "01 Auth → Login" first — {{token}} is saved automatically. List requests save the first id for the detail requests after them.
Bottom nav: HOME · ACADEMICS · ATTENDANCE · NOTIFICATIONS · PROFILE.
